description: This file contains utility functions for handling request parameter filtering for vector store search and creation in a language modeling AI project. It defines a class with static methods to process and filter parameters based on type hints and external configuration classes.

classes.name: VectorStoreRequestUtils
classes.description: Helper utility class providing static methods for constructing and filtering vector store request parameters.

methods.name: VectorStoreSearchOptionalRequestParams get_requested_vector_store_search_optional_param( params: Dict[str, Any], vector_store_provider_config: BaseVectorStoreConfig, )
methods.description: Filters the input parameters to include only those valid for vector store search requests based on type hints, and maps optional parameters through configuration.

methods.name: VectorStoreCreateOptionalRequestParams get_requested_vector_store_create_optional_param( params: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Filters the input parameters to include only those valid for vector store creation requests based on type hints.
